source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The compose Tools settings block now uses #ifndef XP_UNIX. The same file includes its Edit settings block under XP_UNIX plus #ifndef XP_MACOSX. The Account Settings item still dispatches cmd_account, whose compose controller opens the current account's incoming server; Settings still opens paneCompose. This is conditional menu placement rather than removal of the settings commands. The historical discussion includes objections after landing, and no native platform menu was exercised.
title: Compose settings placement follows complementary Unix menu guards
